title: Defining Domestic Workers' Duties and Job Scopes
what_it_is: Defining Domestic Workers' Duties and Job Scopes

sections.label: Foreign domestic workers' duties and training
sections.summary: Laws limit FDWs to household and domestic duties, and employers should ensure FDWs are trained for caregiving tasks requiring special training.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The role of foreign domestic workers (FDWs) in Singapore is already defined in our laws.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Employment of Foreign Manpower Regulations stipulates that FDWs can only perform household and domestic duties.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: However, it is not practical to detail every task for every household as doing so would be overly prescriptive and impractical as the needs vary vastly across households.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: A growing number of employers employ FDWs to assist in caring for children, sick or elderly family members.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: It is in the interest of employers to ensure their FDWs have the skills or are trained to perform caregiving tasks that require special training, for instance, tube feeding, in light of the dangers involved if the caregiver is not trained.

sections.label: Caregivers' Training Grant and reference channel
sections.summary: MOH provides a Caregivers' Training Grant for caregivers including FDWs, and the reference channel only lets employers leave contact details for reference checks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In addition, MOH provides a Caregivers' Training Grant for caregivers of seniors and persons with disabilities, including FDWs, to attend approved training courses to better equip themselves.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The reference channel does not allow anyone, whether employer or FDW, to post comments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The reference channel only provides an option for employers to leave their contact details and make themselves available to provide personal references for their FDWs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: A prospective employer who wishes to find out more about the FDW has to contact the former employer directly to perform the reference check.
